meta_description:
143K likes, 4,117 comments - therock on October 16, 2026: "Another question about fame. 

How has fame changed me? 
It hasn’t. 

I don’t believe fame changes anyone, I believe fame simply magnifies who you are and what you are. Fame will eventually expose what’s inside. 
So be careful if you chase it. 

Here’s a quiet lil’ thing I do, whenever I meet famous people. I always pay sharp attention to how they treat other NON famous people around them. Their teams etc. And especially strangers. Reveals a lot. 

I like our little post workout Rock Talk Q&A’s but geeezus, next time I’ll catch my breath so I don’t sound like I’m trying to inflate a bounce house. 
Wtf 😂".
